Use this index only to find an exact method + route fallback when a generic
proxy is absent. It is not proof a tool is connected or permitted. Inspect the
live schema for required fields and types; send named fields at the top level,
not a generic `path`, `query`, or `body` envelope. Existing curated tools such
as `get_agent`, `save_agent_version`, `get_call_log`, `validate_pathway`,
`upload_knowledge_file`, and `save_code_snippet` are not generated here; inspect
their live contracts separately. No tool in this index covers legacy pathway
workspace saves or pathway chat simulation.
